records.name: db-table-sizes
records.script:
# Розмір, який займає кожна таблиця в БД. Портативно: гілка за діалектом.
# Пісочниця не має доступу до БД — скрипт лише обирає read-only SQL,
# який рушій звітів виконує через той самий SELECT-only guard, що й Query-звіт.
if db_dialect == "postgresql":
    query = """
        SELECT
            c.relname AS object_name,
            CASE c.relkind
                WHEN 'r' THEN 'table'
                WHEN 'm' THEN 'matview'
                WHEN 'p' THEN 'partitioned'
                ELSE c.relkind
            END AS object_type,
            pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS size_bytes,
            ROUND(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) / 1048576.0, 3) AS size_mb,
            ROUND(
                100.0 * pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)
                / NULLIF(pg_database_size(current_database()), 0), 2
            ) AS pct_of_db
        FROM pg_class c
        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
        WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
          AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%'
          AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'm', 'p')
        ORDER BY size_bytes DESC
    """
else:
    query = """
        SELECT
            s.name AS object_name,
            COALESCE(m.type, 'internal') AS object_type,
            SUM(s.pgsize) AS size_bytes,
            ROUND(SUM(s.pgsize) / 1048576.0, 3) AS size_mb,
            ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.pgsize) / (SELECT SUM(pgsize) FROM dbstat), 2) AS pct_of_db
        FROM dbstat s
        LEFT JOIN sqlite_master m ON m.name = s.name
        GROUP BY s.name, m.type
        ORDER BY size_bytes DESC
    """
